title: Custody item body
description: One link of an evidence chain of custody (register row DK1744; spec-delta S1603): for a case, item `n` (from 0) names the hash of the item before it (`prev_item`, `genesis` for the first), what it is, the SHA-256 of the evidence, who holds it and when. Signed by the holder. The holder changes only by an item whose `what` begins `handover:`. The log refuses an item out of order (custody_not_next), one that does not follow the hash of the last (custody_chain_broken), a signer who is not the holder (custody_wrong_issuer) and a holder change without a handover (custody_holder_changed). Chain: none (prev is null).
